proposed_widenings.name: Duration: permanent
proposed_widenings.justification: Arcane Lock has a permanent duration (until dispelled by Dispel Magic). The current Duration type only has instantaneous, concentration, and timed. A permanent-until-dispelled duration cannot be honestly represented.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "magically lock it for the duration" — duration field: {"type": "permanent", "ends": ["dispel"]}

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment: object
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell targets a physical object (door, window, gate, container, or hatch), not a creature. The v4 taxonomy includes an 'object' attachment atom, but the surface Attachment type has no object variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it"

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: lock_object (block_access)
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanical effect is preventing nonmagical unlocking/opening of the object. No existing OngoingOperation variant covers access-blocking; roll_modifier and damage_on_hit are the only options. The v4 atom 'block_travel' is the closest match but is not surfaced as an operation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This lock can't be unlocked by any nonmagical means."

notes: Arcane Lock is structurally closest to ongoing_effect (persistent state applied to a target, no combat resolution, no concentration) but requires three surface widenings before it can be encoded: a permanent Duration variant, an object Attachment variant, and an access-blocking OngoingOperation variant. Secondary omission: the password mechanic (spoken within 5 ft unlocks for 1 minute) would require a further conditional-suppression sub-trigger mechanism beyond these three widenings and is not the primary blocker.
